## Purpose
The rule catalog: every rule type the platform can enforce, with its scope, the checkpoints where it runs, its allowed enforcements, its form fields and its plain-language summary template. It also normalises parameters and renders summaries.

## Responsibilities
- **Vocabulary:**
  - `SCOPES` is agent and workflow;
  - `BUILTIN_CATEGORIES` are safety, data, tools, quality and limits, each with an icon, colour and description;
  - `PATTERN_MODES` is keywords or regex. `ENFORCEMENTS` is block, warn, fix. `OUTCOMES`;
  - **`CHECKPOINTS`** maps each checkpoint to its label: creation, message, tool_call, answer, run, synthesis, validate, run_start, step, step_result;
  - `PII_TYPES` are email, phone, card, national_id and ip;
  - `MODERATION_CATEGORIES` are jailbreaking, dangerous, criminal, selfharm, hate_and_discrimination, violence_and_threats, sexual and pii;
  - `STRICTNESS` is relaxed 0.9, balanced 0.7, strict 0.5;
  - `DATA_CLASSES` are pii, financial and health;
  - `DEFAULT_BLOCKED_PHRASES` are five prompt-injection phrases.
- **`ParamField`** has key, label, kind (tags, multiselect, number, select, checkboxes, toggle or text), default, help, options, `options_source` (tools, connectors or models), min and max.
- **`RuleType`** has key, scope, name, description, category, icon, checkpoints, enforcements, default_enforcement, summary, params and enforcement_help, plus `defaults()` and `to_dict()`, which adds `checkpoint_labels`.
- **`_types()`** defines 23 rule types. The exact text is in the source and must be copied verbatim.
  - **Agent rules:** content_moderation (fix), database_read_only, blocked_tools, approved_connectors, tool_call_limit (default 5, 1–10), blocked_phrases, agent_custom_pattern, pii_redaction, json_answers, answer_length (default 4000, 200–50000), approved_models (default large, medium and small "-latest"), instruction_quality (default 200, 20–5000) and reviewed_tools_only.
  - **Workflow rules:** capability_coverage, sensitive_data_internal, screen_input_first, documents_match_domain, step_limit (default 30, 1–50), blocked_connectors, input_screening, result_redaction, workflow_custom_pattern and agent_step_tool_limit (default 10, 1–20).
- **Lookups:** `RULE_TYPES`, `get_type(key)` and `types_for(scope)`.
- **`normalise_params(rule_type, params)`:**
  - fills in defaults;
  - numbers are clamped and become ints when whole;
  - list kinds are coerced to lists of stripped strings;
  - text is at most 500 chars;
  - select values must be valid options;
  - unknown keys are dropped.
- **`render_summary(rule_type, params)`:**
  - fills the template with option labels, joining lists with ", " or "none";
  - adds `required_keys_suffix` and the `check_on` wording;
  - falls back to the description on a format error.

## Key elements
`RULE_TYPES`, `RuleType`, `ParamField`, `normalise_params`, `render_summary`, `CHECKPOINTS`, `BUILTIN_CATEGORIES`.

## Control flow
Pure.

None.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Used by:** `rules.store` (validation and summaries), `engine` and the rules routes (the forms on the Rules page).

## Error handling and edge cases
- A summary format error falls back to the description.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Agent and workflow rule types never overlap.**
- **`reviewed_tools_only` only works as an always-on rule.** Tool generation happens before any agent exists to attach it to.
- **The form schema drives the UI.** Rules are never edited as raw JSON.

## How to rebuild this file
Copy the vocabularies and all 23 type definitions verbatim, then implement the helpers.
